message.notAi: We couldn't confirm this is AI-generated, so it's been sent for human review.

message.explicit: Blocked: explicit content isn't allowed on AItube.

message.realPersonDeepfake: Hard-blocked: this appears to depict a real, identifiable person without consent. Non-consensual likeness is not permitted and is not auto-appealable.

help.title: Creator help bot
help.subtitle: Ask about uploads, our content policy, or why a specific video was flagged.
help.greeting: Hi! I can explain uploads, our content policy, and why any of your videos was flagged or blocked. What do you need?
help.error: Sorry, I couldn't answer that right now.
help.statusProcessing: This video is still going through the safety pipeline.
help.policySummary: AItube only hosts AI-generated video, and every upload must clear a pre-publish safety pipeline: we confirm it's AI, read its provenance (C2PA), and scan for explicit content, graphic violence, and non-consensual real-person likeness. Clean videos publish with an AI-Verified badge; ambiguous ones go to human review; explicit/violent content and real-person deepfakes are blocked.

provenance.title: AI content disclosure
provenance.disclosureBody: This video is AI-generated. Provenance is read from C2PA Content Credentials where available (EU AI Act Art. 50 disclosure).
